fact_english: The sampaguita, the national flower of the Philippines, did not start out there: botanists list it as native to Bhutan and India.
source_onscreen: Pinagmulan: Kew, Plants of the World Online

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang sampaguita, pambansang bulaklak natin, hindi pala dito nagsimula: katutubo ito ng Bhutan at India, ayon sa mga botaniko.

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Dayo, pero dito umuwi. Welcome, sampaguita.

after_text: Doon sila nakatira, kung saan may kasinungalingan.
